J3.evidence: Reviewer misread the English. Arabic: «فرارًا: مفعول به ثانٍ، والاستثناء مفرغ». English: 'second mafʿūl bihi; and the exception is "emptied" (mufarragh, i.e. with no stated excepted-from)' -- it says NO stated excepted-from (al-mustathnā minhu is not mentioned), which is exactly what istithnāʾ mufarragh means; no negation reversal. The short parenthetical is the first-use technical-term gloss allowed by glossary_en.md rule 6, not a substantive addition. Other lines (فلم, يزدهم first object, دعائي fāʿil, إلا ḥaṣr) are all faithful.
